title: Privacy policy
translationNotice: This is an English translation provided for convenience; the German version is legally binding.

controller.heading: 1. Controller
controller.intro: The controller within the meaning of the GDPR and the German Federal Data Protection Act (BDSG) is:
controller.addressLines:
[First name and surname / Company]
[Street and house number]
[Postal code, City]

overview.heading: 2. Quick overview: what we process

items.auth: Registration and login data (email, password hash, name, 2FA)
items.portfolio: Portfolio, transaction, watchlist and alert data
items.ai: Your questions to the AI (analysis prompts) and the corresponding responses
items.usage: Usage logs for billing and cost-cap (tokens, estimated USD cost per call)
items.tech: Technical data (session cookie, IP address used for rate limiting)

overview.footer: We do not sell any data and do not use tracking pixels.

registration.heading: 3. Registration and user account
registration.body: To create a user account we store your email address, password (as a bcrypt hash), optionally your name, and your settings. Processing is based on the performance of a contract (Art. 6 (1) (b) GDPR). The data is erased as soon as you delete your account — see “Account deletion” below.

cookie.heading: 4. Session cookie
cookie.body: We set a single strictly-necessary cookie named sa_session (HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, Secure in production). It contains a signed JSON Web Token used to identify your session and is valid for 30 days. Legal basis: Art. 6 (1) (b) GDPR in conjunction with § 25 (2) (2) TDDDG (strictly necessary, no consent required).

portfolioData.heading: 5. Portfolio and analysis data
portfolioData.body: The tickers, quantities, transactions, notes, watchlist entries and alerts you create are stored in our MongoDB database. They are isolated per user ID; other users cannot see them (exception: watchlists or magazine analyses that you explicitly share). Legal basis: Art. 6 (1) (b) GDPR.

ai.heading: 6. AI providers (third-country transfer)
ai.intro: For AI-assisted analyses we transfer the text of your request and the portfolio/price data required for the task to the AI provider configured by you or by the administrator:

providers.anthropic: Anthropic PBC (Claude) — recipient located in the United States. Anthropic provides Standard Contractual Clauses. No training data is derived from API calls (Anthropic Commercial Terms).
providers.google: Google LLC (Gemini) — recipient located in the EU or the United States. Google provides Standard Contractual Clauses.
providers.openai: OpenAI and OpenAI-compatible providers — depending on the base URL chosen by the user; for OpenAI directly: recipient in the United States, Standard Contractual Clauses.

ai.footer: Legal basis: Art. 6 (1) (b) GDPR (performance of contract) in conjunction with Art. 49 (1) (b) GDPR for the third-country transfer. Avoid entering personal data of third parties into your AI prompts.

marketData.heading: 7. External market data
marketData.body: To display quotes, news and fundamentals we fetch (server-side, so that your IP address does not reach the third party) data from Yahoo Finance (Yahoo Inc., USA) and, as a fallback, Stooq (Poland). Only ticker symbols are transmitted; no personal data.

email.heading: 8. Transactional email
email.body: To confirm email addresses, send password resets, digest mails and alert notifications, we send email via an SMTP service. The provider is: [enter SMTP host, e.g. Strato, Postmark, Resend]. Legal basis: Art. 6 (1) (b) GDPR.

rateLimit.heading: 9. Rate limiting and logging
rateLimit.body: To prevent abuse, we keep IP addresses of registration and login attempts in memory for a short time (rate limiting). AI calls are logged in UsageLog for billing, cost caps and admin statistics (no IP, only user ID, operation, token count, estimated cost). Legal basis: Art. 6 (1) (f) GDPR (legitimate interest in stable operation and abuse prevention).

hosting.heading: 10. Hosting and data location
hosting.body: The application and the MongoDB database are operated on [enter host, location Germany/EU].

rights.heading: 11. Your rights
rights.intro: You have the right, at any time, to:
rights.complaintBefore: Lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority (Art. 77 GDPR). The authority of your federal state is competent; a list is available at
rights.selfServiceBefore: Access, export and deletion can be performed directly in the
rights.selfServiceAfter: via the “Export my data” and “Delete account” features — or by emailing the controller named above.

retention.heading: 12. Retention period
retention.body: We retain your data for as long as your user account is active and erase it without undue delay after account deletion. Statutory retention obligations (e.g. under § 147 AO for invoices once paid services are introduced) remain unaffected.

changes.heading: 13. Changes to this policy
changes.body: We will inform you by email at the address on file about any material changes to this policy.
